entries.claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC full-tensor potential theorem excludes a nondegenerate fixed-boundary Einstein-radiative form obtained solely through local Lee-Wald/JKM ambiguities of the pure C^2 action. It does not exclude an enlarged p0/p1 source-response phase space, construct Bondi BV-BFV ghosts/antifields, classify Coulombic or logarithmic data, match I-/i0/I+, compute P0 or D_M charges, or establish causal, particle, scattering, stability, positivity, unitarity or quantum claims.

dispersion.statement: The theorem uses arbitrary compact-support retarded-time profiles, not a frequency-shell classification.

lee_wald.statement: Theta_C2^a=2*sqrt(-g)*(P^(abcd)*nabla_d(delta g_bc)-(nabla_d P^(abcd))*delta g_bc); No local counterterm/corner ambiguity built only from the existing metric jets can produce a finite nondegenerate fixed-boundary Einstein-radiative symplectic form in pure C^2 gravity.

resonance.statement: No compact harmonic resonance functional is mapped to this asymptotic carrier.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The result is linear and uses compact-support retarded-time profiles.

causal_retarded.statement: No retarded Bondi BV--BFV Green carrier is constructed.

taub_maps.statement: No compact-slice second-order Taub map is part of this linear null-boundary theorem.

scope.background: Minkowski space in one fixed conformal completion
scope.boundaries: local cuts of I+; compact-support-in-u radiative test subspace
scope.carrier: full metric tensor in the bulk, restricted for the no-go to flat Einstein Jacobi fields with Bondi shear C_AB/r
scope.charge_sector: zero Coulombic aspects; fixed leading unphysical boundary metric
scope.ell: all radiative tensor harmonics for which the Einstein Jacobi and compact-u-support conditions hold
scope.k: radial Bondi expansion, not compact momentum
scope.m: all; angular integration is local and the witness survives restriction to one component
scope.parity: both tracefree sphere-tensor polarizations; one polarization supplies the nonexactness witness
scope.theory: linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity
